title: ר' שמעון בן גודע

paragraphs: R' Shimon ben Guda, a tanna of a baraita in Avodah Zarah 32a, testified before Rabban Gamliel's son. It says there: “R' Shimon ben Goda testified before Rabban Gamliel's son concerning Rabban Gamliel, that he drank ….” Heilprin adopts the Talmud’s alternative that there were two, one ben Guda and one ben Goda; see his entry.
